# Vendor sync glyphs

Custom scalable line artwork following the approved pending-sync cloud/clock.
`pending.svg` is the cloud and clock. `cloud.svg` is the fixed cloud silhouette;
`arrows.svg` is the separate rotating transfer symbol. The sent cloud/check
continues to use the established app icon. No brand/logo artwork is replaced.

MNSyncGlyph controls tint and animation from the real sync state. The arrow
rotation uses the existing 800 ms motion token, stops for reduced motion and
inactive ticker scopes, and disposes with the widget. Assets contain no scripts,
external image references or font dependencies.
